# GoogleTest runtime subset

Vendored from GoogleTest v1.18.0.

Source archive:
https://github.com/google/googletest/archive/refs/tags/v1.18.0.zip

Only the GoogleTest runtime headers and sources required by CX tests are kept.
GoogleMock, upstream tests, samples, docs, CI files, and Bazel metadata are omitted.
See `LICENSE` for Google's BSD-3-Clause license.
